The shopping mall looked quieter than usual that evening. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. What's more, a voucher came as a goodwill gesture.
Little by little, things began to change. Nina plans to study history harder this term. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. She drove a hard bargain at the yard sale.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Nina's dream job is to be a doctor. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, my classmates shouted from the side of the field.

On Thursday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Nina will take part in a football match in November. Eat more vegetables and fruit.
Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There are always more possibilities than we expect. People around Nina often share different ideas about the shopping mall.
